headline: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore launches new tools for AI agent deployment and management

items.title: Third-party cyber evaluations involving OpenAI models
items.summary: OpenAI has addressed recent third-party cybersecurity evaluation incidents, detailing the new safeguards implemented to enhance the testing and evaluation of their AI models. These measures aim to mitigate potential security vulnerabilities during model assessment. OpenAI's transparency in sharing these updates underscores their commitment to maintaining secure AI deployments.
items.why_it_matters: Understanding the security measures in AI model evaluations is critical for developers to ensure safe and reliable AI tool deployment.

items.title: Introducing Shieldstral
items.summary: Mistral AI has launched Shieldstral, a 3B open-weights multimodal safety classifier that claims to outperform models up to seven times its size. This release is designed to enhance the safety and reliability of AI systems by providing robust classification capabilities across multiple data modalities.

items.title: Deploy local agents everywhere with LFM2.5-2.6B
items.summary: Hugging Face has announced the release of LiquidAI's LFM2.5-2.6B models, designed for efficient deployment of local AI agents. These models support flexible integration in diverse environments, enabling developers to leverage powerful AI capabilities locally.

items.title: Run production AI agents in n8n with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is now generally available, allowing seamless integration of AI agents into n8n workflows. The open-source node enables developers to build agents with persistent memory, code execution, and VPC isolation directly from the n8n editor, facilitating robust automation without specific infrastructure dependencies.

items.title: Introducing Web Search on Amazon Bedrock for foundation model grounding
items.summary: Amazon has released Web Search as a built-in tool on Bedrock, allowing foundation models to ground their responses in current web knowledge. This new server-side capability eliminates the need for third-party vendors, streamlining the integration process and enhancing the accuracy of AI outputs.

items.title: Changes at Google DeepMind: Demis Hassabis from CEO to Chair, Jeff Dean departs
items.summary: Google DeepMind is undergoing significant leadership changes with Demis Hassabis transitioning from CEO to Chairman, and Jeff Dean leaving the company. This reshuffle is part of a broader strategic reorientation at DeepMind as it continues to scale its AI innovations.

Three coordinated agents use LangGraph, the Model Context Protocol, and Amazon Nova models with built-in guardrails to deliver 24/7 personalized mortgage guidance while meeting strict financial-services compliance.

all_items.title: How Mobileye transformed support operations using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
all_items.summary: In this post, we'll explore how Mobileye deployed an AI support agentic solution on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore - from the support bottleneck that sparked the idea, through the proof of concept that validated it, to the hybrid architecture that bridges on-premises systems with AWS cloud services. This approach is relevant for enterprises struggling to scale AI Agents while maintaining enterprise grade governance and security standards.

all_items.title: How we built an MCP bridge to give our AgentCore-hosted AI agent access to local MCP tools
all_items.summary: AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore run in the cloud, but users' tools and files live on their laptops. Learn how to build a secure MCP bridge that lets a cloud-hosted agent call local MCP servers by tunneling signed messages over the existing WebSocket connection through a browser extension and Chrome native messaging, with no open ports or VPN required.
